source_publication: Government of Tamil Nadu, Higher Secondary Second Year Economics, 2019 first edition, SCERT / Department of School Education
source_reading_method: Original 2019 government-published textbook PDF text and printed page labels inspected; selected statements compared with a 2024 transcribed SCERT reprint; high-stakes historical firsts cross-checked with institutional primary sources

evidence.claim_summary: Ragnar Frisch shared first Economic Sciences prize, 1969
evidence.source_text_location: Chapter 1, Introduction, paragraph on macroeconomic terms

evidence.claim_summary: Sveriges Riksbank is oldest central bank, founded 1668 (not 1656 predecessor)
evidence.source_text_location: Section 6.2 Historical Development; book prints variant spelling 'Ricks Banks' and predecessor date 1656

evidence.claim_summary: Sir Osborne Smith was first RBI Governor on 1 April 1935
evidence.source_text_location: Reserve Bank of India History infographic and caption

evidence.claim_summary: Sher Shah Suri issued silver Rupiya, precursor of modern rupee (not India's first coin)
evidence.source_text_location: Rupee origin note adjacent to RBI history infographic

evidence.claim_summary: First WTO Ministerial Conference met in Singapore 9–13 December 1996

excluded_claims.textbook_claim_summary: Simon Kuznets first introduced the concept of national income
excluded_claims.reason: National income ideas and estimates predate Kuznets; his pioneering US national income accounts do not prove he was first to introduce the concept globally.

excluded_claims.textbook_claim_summary: Bank of England (1864) called first bank of issues
excluded_claims.reason: Bank of England was founded in 1694; neither 1864 first issue nor unqualified worldwide first banking-issues claim independently supported.

excluded_claims.textbook_claim_summary: Oldest central bank sprang from a private bank established in 1656
excluded_claims.reason: Stockholms Banco 1656 is predecessor; Sveriges Riksbank established 1668, confirmed by primary bank history.

notes: 2019 PDF printed text is the provenance source. The web screenshot tool returned a file-size error, so page images are not verified. The 2024 transcript is an additional edition-text comparison, not a substitute for its original PDF. Source URLs are mirrored/secondary; Government of Tamil Nadu publication identity identified on the inner title page.
